Distinctions

  • President's Club - Award

    GAF entrusts a select few Master Elite® contractors* as President’s Club status, showing excellence in performance, reliability, and service --- signifying a commitment to installing roofing systems that qualify for GAF’s best warranties.


  • GAF Master Elite® - Certification

    GAF entrusts Master Elite® contractors* to offer our strongest warranties including the Golden Pledge® Limited Warranty** on qualifying roof systems.

  • GAF Certified Plus™ - Certification

    GAF entrusts Certified Plus™ contractors* to offer our System Plus® Limited Warranty** and our Silver Pledge™ Limited Warranty** on qualifying roof systems.

  • GAF Certified™ - Certification

    GAF Certified™ contractors* can offer one of GAF’s enhanced warranties, the System Plus Limited Warranty.**


  • GAF National Circle™ Contractor - Designation

    GAF National Circle™ contractors* demonstrate a commitment to scaling excellence across a national footprint by meeting the stringent criteria required for this exclusive designation.

*Contractors who are enrolled in GAF certification programs or are recipients of the GAF National Circle™ Contractor designation are not employees or agents of GAF, and GAF does not control or otherwise supervise these independent businesses. Contractors may receive benefits, such as loyalty rewards points, and discounts on marketing tools from GAF for holding this designation and offering GAF products. Your dealings with a Contractor, and any services they provide to you, are subject to the Contractor Terms of Use.

**Eligibility requirements, coverage, terms and restrictions apply and vary based on the enhanced warranty and products installed. For details and to view full System Plus, Silver Pledge and Golden Pledge Limited Warranties visit gaf.com/en-us/for-homeowners/warranties/residential. Visit gaf.com/LRS for qualifying GAF products.

Specialty Roofing

  • Metal

    Merging time-tested materials with cutting-edge technology, the TimberSteel™ premium metal roofing system is durable, beautiful and more affordable than you imagine.

  • FORTIFIED Roof™

    GAF contractors are certified to install a FORTIFIED Roof™, an elevated standard that goes beyond building code based on decades of research of the Insurance Institute for Business & Home Safety funded by many homeowners insurance carriers.

  • Solar

    Our innovative nailable solar shingle roof systems are backed by our Timberline Solar™ Shingle and Accessory Limited Warranty.

GAF Certifications and Awards for roofers near you

GAF President’s Club Award

GAF President’s Club Award three-star winners are considered the best of the best among Master Elite® contractors. These contractors can offer the GAF President’s Club Limited Warranty.

GAF Master Elite®

GAF Master Elite® contractors are entrusted to offer GAF enhanced warranties including the Golden Pledge® Limited Warranty.*

GAF Certified Plus™

GAF Certified Plus™ contractors can offer GAF enhanced warranties including System Plus and Silver Pledge™ limited warranties.*

GAF Certified™

GAF Certified™ contractors can offer one of GAF’s enhanced warranties, the System Plus Limited Warranty.*
*Eligibility requirements, coverage, terms and restrictions apply and vary based on the enhanced warranty and products installed. To view full warranties, visit here. Visit gaf.com/LRS for qualifying GAf products.
